query: What drives praise and complaints in Amazon reviews?

per_column.name: performance_vs_advertised_spec
per_column.rationale: Whether a product performs relative to its advertised specification is a genuine aspect/driver of praise and complaints -- a substantive dimension along which reviewers evaluate.

per_column.name: content_quality_aspect
per_column.rationale: Content-quality dimensions (plot, production, character, pacing) are constitutive aspects that drive praise/complaint for media items; a legitimate facet of what reviewers react to.

per_column.name: expectation_gap_direction
per_column.rationale: Whether the product fell short/met/exceeded expectations is essentially the outcome polarity of praise vs complaint, not an independent driver of it; it restates the valence rather than decomposing its causes.

per_column.name: intended_use_fit
per_column.rationale: Fit for intended use case is a distinct evaluative dimension driving satisfaction/dissatisfaction, a real aspect of the drivers concept.

per_column.name: reviewer_emotional_intensity
per_column.rationale: Emotional intensity measures the strength of the praise/complaint expression itself, not a constitutive driver of what caused it; it characterizes the reaction, not its aspects.

per_column.name: recommendation_stance
per_column.rationale: Recommend / do-not-recommend is a downstream expression of overall sentiment (a summary of praise vs complaint), not a facet decomposing the drivers behind it.

judge.rationale: Only three of six columns are true constitutive facets of the drivers concept (spec performance, content quality, intended-use fit). The remaining three characterize the reaction itself: expectation_gap_direction and recommendation_stance restate overall valence/sentiment, and reviewer_emotional_intensity measures expression strength rather than a driver. Mutual exclusivity is moderate: performance_vs_advertised_spec, expectation_gap_direction, and intended_use_fit substantially overlap in capturing 'did it match expectations of what/how it should perform,' and the three non-facets all echo overall sentiment. Exhaustiveness is weak: even among valid facets, major driver categories such as price/value, build/durability, delivery/packaging/shipping, and customer service are absent, so the set does not cover the concept's main constitutive aspects.
